1.sahih_international: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
1.pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
1.yusuf_ali: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
1.shakir: Perdition overtake both hands of Abu Lahab, and he will perish.
1.muhammad_sarwar: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish!
1.mohsin_khan: Perish the two hands of Abu Lahab (an uncle of the Prophet), and perish he!
1.arberry: Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and perish he!

2.sahih_international: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
2.pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
2.yusuf_ali: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
2.shakir: His wealth and what he earns will not avail him.
2.mohsin_khan: His wealth and his children (etc.) will not benefit him!
2.arberry: His wealth avails him not, neither what he has earned;

3.sahih_international: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
3.pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
3.yusuf_ali: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
3.shakir: He shall soon burn in fire that flames,
3.muhammad_sarwar: His property and worldly gains will be of no help to him.
3.mohsin_khan: He will be burnt in a Fire of blazing flames!
3.arberry: he shall roast at a flaming fire

4.sahih_international: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
4.yusuf_ali: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
4.shakir: And his wife, the bearer of fuel,
4.muhammad_sarwar: He will suffer in a blazing fire
4.mohsin_khan: And his wife too, who carries wood (thorns of Sadan which she used to put on the way of the Prophet (Peace be upon him), or use to slander him).
4.arberry: and his wife, the carrier of the firewood,

5.sahih_international: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
5.pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
5.yusuf_ali: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
5.shakir: Upon her neck a halter of strongly twisted rope.
5.muhammad_sarwar: and so too will his wife who (threw thorns and firewood in the Prophet's way). Around her neck will be a rope of palm fibre.
5.mohsin_khan: In her neck is a twisted rope of Masad (palm fibre).
5.arberry: upon her neck a rope of palm-fibre.
